newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat closes lower on good crop weather.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat closes lower on good crop weather.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed lower on good crop weather for the U.S. winter and spring wheat growing regions, traders said.
Meteorologists said rain was forecast for dry northwest Kansas late Thursday and Friday but the market was underpinned by firm cash basis markets and slow farmer selling, the traders said.
"Mills are hand to mouth and would like to see some harvest activity," the trader said.
KCBT wheat futures finished unchanged to 7-1/2 cents lower, with July down 6-3/4 at $4.07 per bushel.
Wheat futures volume was estimated by KCBT at 36.505 million bushels, above the 24.150 million traded Wednesday.
